patch.summary:
Choose Hootsuite only if your buying job matches “Major social media suite (Social OS) — Standard/Professional/Advanced published seats plus” rather than SocialBee's shape. Choose SocialBee only if your buying job matches “SocialBee is a social media management platform for planning, AI content, scheduling acros” rather than Hootsuite's shape. Workflow advantage: Hootsuite leans social-media-marketing, brand-monitoring; SocialBee leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: Hootsuite is Major social media suite (Social OS) — Standard/Professional/Advanced published seats plus Enterprise custom.; SocialBee is SocialBee is a social media management platform for planning, AI content, scheduling across major networks, analytics, and agency workspaces.
- Company-size focus: Hootsuite (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs SocialBee (small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Hootsuite-leaning social-media-marketing, brand-monitoring, content-marketing vs SocialBee-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Hootsuite — Higher seat cost than Buffer/Later entry schedulers; SocialBee — Profile and workspace caps by plan.

Limitations — Hootsuite: Higher seat cost than Buffer/Later entry schedulers; Enterprise listening/governance gated to top tiers; SocialBee: Profile and workspace caps by plan; Historical analytics depth limited on Bootstrap (3 months).
